findings.page_quote: compatibility row fields: endpoint definition: primary outcome was incidence of postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF); follow-up window: 14 days; analysis set: intention-to-treat

source_evidence.quote: RESULTS: Of 163 analyzed patients (81 colchicine, 82 placebo)

findings.claim: The row labels the pooled result intention-to-treat, although the abstract describes 172 randomized participants and only 163 analyzed. The supplied source does not establish an intention-to-treat analysis; the page elsewhere correctly identifies this as AVAILABLE_CASE.

source_evidence.quote: The regimen included a preoperative loading dose (1 mg twice daily) followed by a weight-based maintenance dose (0.5 mg daily if <70 kg; 1 mg daily if ≥70 kg) for 14 days.

findings.claim: The cited duration describes drug administration, not outcome surveillance. It does not establish the 14-day follow-up window attributed to this trial.

findings.page_quote: 32720823 PMID 32720823 HM: retrieved source does not report this harm

source_evidence.quote: Diarrhea occurred in two patients in each group and necessitated treatment discontinuation in one patient in each group.

findings.claim: The abstract explicitly reports treatment discontinuation due to diarrhea in one patient per arm. A binder refusal does not justify labelling this outcome unreported.

findings.page_quote: 25172965 Gastrointestinal adverse effects REFUSED_ON_EVIDENCE REASON_FALSE_VALUE_HELD abstract:25172965

source_evidence.quote: Adverse events occurred in 21 patients (11.7%) in the placebo group vs 36 (20.0%) in the colchicine group

findings.claim: The audit incorrectly treats overall adverse-event counts as a held gastrointestinal-specific value. The quoted source does not identify those counts as gastrointestinal events, so it does not establish that the outcome-specific refusal is false.

source_evidence.quote: Adverse events occurred in 21 patients (11.7%) in the placebo group vs 36 (20.0%) in the colchicine group (absolute difference, 8.3%; 95% CI; 0.76%-15.9%; number needed to harm = 12), but discontinuation rates were similar.

findings.claim: The audit flags a held numerical discontinuation value, but its evidence supplies adverse-event counts and only a qualitative statement about discontinuation. It does not contradict the refusal for missing discontinuation counts or an effect with CI.

codex.note: Approximate manual recomputation. Two trial tuples have null effects and CIs, so their RRs and Wald log variances were reconstructed from the supplied counts: 13/81 versus 13/71 and 61/180 versus 75/180. Used variance 1/a−1/n1+1/c−1/n0 for those rows and the specified CI-derived SE for RR 0.37 (0.21–0.66). Paule–Mandel tau² ≈0.146522; HKSJ variance factor 1; t with 2 df ≈4.302653. Agreement verifies arithmetic for the served membership, not completeness.
